verdict.rationale: Docs show Fin ingests external content via URL import (createContentImportSource), syncing websites, 'Adding content to Fin', and works alongside helpdesks like Zendesk/Salesforce without manual re-authoring, plus multi-content-source support (help center, docs, wikis via sync). Missing for 10: no direct evidence of ticket-history ingestion or internal wiki-specific connectors, and no independent/hands-on validation of ingestion quality or completeness.
